newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UPS rivals to see small boost.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UPS rivals to see small boost.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said a teamsters strike at United Parcel Service of America Inc may drive some business to rivals such as Federal Express Corp, Airborne Freight Corp, CNF Transportation Inc, Consolidated Freightways Inc, Roadway Express Inc and Yellow Corp.
-- said while rivals may see some extra business, "a lift to earnings may be temporary and would not signal a buying opportunity."

-- "while UPS bemoans the possibility of a permanent traffic loss if there is a walkout, we think this risk is minimal because the giant company likely will aggressively recapture lost buiness through promotional marketing."
-- said expects any walkout to be brief due to inadequate strike funds in the union's coffers or perhaps due to federal action.
